description: Parse, normalize and clean a URL (components, query params, punycode, tracking params removed). Splits a URL into scheme, host (Unicode and punycode), port, path, query parameters and fragment; returns a normalized form (lowercase host, default port dropped, sorted query) and a clean form with tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, ...) removed. No network access. Price: $0.003 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
